use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: To enter a treatment claim and validate it manually and through the system.

scope_contract.goal_statement: To enter a treatment claim and validate it manually and through the system.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The MSIU Field Office User enters a treatment claim and validates the claim form manually and through the system.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The MSIU Field Office User is ready to enter a treatment claim in the system.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The treatment claim has been entered and the claim form has been validated manually and through the system.
in_scope_actions: enter applicable treatment data based on the MSIU treatment master
validate the claim form through the system
excluded_adjacent_actions: VSP submission of the claim to the MSIU Field Office
MSIU office processing of the claim after validation
downstream claim disposition or administrative processing
variant_dimensions: Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drug, and Other Measure selections

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU Field Office User is ready to enter a treatment claim in the system.
The claim form for the treatment claim has been received by the MSIU Field Office from the VSP.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates 'Claim Entry' to process a Treatment (claims) Form submitted by the VSP.
Before entering the claim, the MSIU Field Office User manually checks the Treatment (claims) Form to determine whether any mandatory information is missing.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates claim entry in the Claim Processing system and enters the Treatment Form No; the system captures the Treatment Form No and Claim No.
When the Form No is chosen, the system automatically populates the Submitted Date and VSP Name.
The system captures Voucher No, Visit Count, and Patient Type from the Bar Code reader based on the Voucher Slip Stick on the Claim Form.

Based on the Voucher No entered, the system automatically populates Client Details (Address), Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated fields.

The MSIU Field Office User manually enters the remaining claim form data exactly as recorded on the manual claim form; during this entry the system captures the additional master information for the claim, including Patient Name, Age, Gender, Contact No, Doctor Name, Doctor's Note, HIV Details, Patient Status, Claim Amount, and Claim Status.
The MSIU Field Office User validates the claim using a thumb-print reader for biometric verification.

Upon saving, the system validates every captured data element—voucher number, clinical information, diagnosis details, drug and investigation details, and costs—against the Database and only accepts the claim if the mandatory information is complete.
After validation, the system processes the claim and updates the Database with the validated claim information.

missing_aspects: Evidence EC-MF-030 lists 'Submitted Date', 'VSP Name', 'Voucher No', 'Visit Count', 'Patient Type', and 'Address' as captured master information, which are not included in the claim's list.

claims.content: The system allows the user to enter any number of Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs and Other Measures in any treatment level based on MSIU treatment master.
Diverges from Step 6 when the date of sale is a past date: the system uses the current system date as the date of distribution while accepting the past date of sale.

claims.content: At Step 1, during the manual check of the Treatment (claims) Form before claim entry, if the MSIU Field Office User finds that mandatory information is missing, the user marks the Claim (Treatment Form) status as Rejected and sends it back to the VSP.

At Step 8, because all master-level information other than Contact No is mandatory and the system only accepts claims if mandatory information is complete, if any mandatory information is missing or any false information exists, the system changes the claim status to 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine', stores the claim in the quarantine area, and captures the reason for this status; the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP.

At Step 8, quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification. If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claim will be entered onto the system in the following month's batch. If the VSP returns the claim without satisfactory details, it does not proceed to re-entry in the following month's batch, indicating termination or permanent rejection of that claim instance within this use case.

At Step 7, if the thumb impression captured in the claim form mismatches previous visits for the same voucher number for the same patient/client/partner, the system automatically makes a count; if a claim from the same VSP has more than two thumb impression mismatches, the system produces a warning message and automatically In-Activates the VSP.
At Step 8, the system includes a future date sale validation check available to handle cases where the date of sale is in the future.
The field office validates the claim form manually and through the system.
The Database has been updated with the validated claim information.
